Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes. Role Overview Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU.

In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract Workplace: Remote Requirements University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience; Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above; Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement); Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time; Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events; Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values; Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures); Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments; Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models); Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting; Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration; Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist; Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset; Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset; Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions; Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox; Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog; Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery; Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement; Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices; Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress; Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five); Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards; Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks; Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve; Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g.

Azure DevOps, Confluence); Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes; Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team; Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

Every sprint that ships depends on someone keeping ceremonies structured, blockers visible, and Jira data trustworthy. Without that, planning drifts, standups run long without resolving anything, and status reports stop reflecting what teams shipped. The Scrum Master owns that day-to-day discipline for one or more Platform teams, especially teams still building their agile habits, so the team can focus on delivery instead of process friction.

Ceremony Facilitation
Facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for assigned teams, keeping sessions time-boxed and outcome-focused.
Support charter reviews and team kickoffs, helping new or forming teams set working agreements and delivery expectations.
Document ceremony decisions and action items so commitments carry over cleanly between sprints.
Team Support & Impediment Removal
Support teams new to agile in applying Scrum mechanics day to day, resolving confusion before it slows delivery.
Identify and escalate blockers quickly enough that they don't carry over into the next sprint.
Encourage open retrospectives and follow through on improvement commitments until they're implemented.
Jira & Delivery Tracking
Maintain Jira boards and backlog health for assigned teams, keeping stories current and sprints configured correctly.
Track and report team-level delivery metrics (velocity, sprint completion rate, open impediments) using Platform-standard Jira dashboards.
Give stakeholders concise, accurate delivery status updates based on what the team completed.
AI-Assisted Support
Use AI-assisted tools to support ceremony prep, note capture, and status reporting, cutting down manual admin work.

2+ years working as a Scrum Master or in an agile delivery support role within a technology team.
Working knowledge of Scrum principles and ceremonies, with experience running or co-facilitating them.
Familiarity with Jira for sprint tracking, story management, and basic dashboard configuration.
Strong communication and organizational skills, with a track record of keeping teams on track and following through on commitments.
Comfort supporting teams that are still building their agile practice, adjusting approach as the team matures.

Scrum certification (CSM, PSM I, or equivalent).
Experience supporting technology teams in Software Engineering, IT infrastructure, or enterprise environments.
Comfort with AI productivity tools or interest in applying automation to reduce repetitive work.
Experience working within an organization with established agile standards.

The Coca-Cola Company is evolving into a more digital - first, data - driven enterprise to fuel sustainable growth, increase speed to market, and unlock new sources of value.

Rapid advances in technology, data, and AI create a unique opportunity to accelerate The Coca-Cola Company (TCCC) system's next chapter of growth by reimagining our core competitive advantages .

Building on a strong foundation of modernized infrastructure, global digital experiences, early data capabilities, and proven use cases, we are now shifting from early wins to scaled, end to end impact on growth, productivity, and efficiency .
This next phase moves us from an analog world to a fully digitized one, powered by a digital growth engine that embeds data, technology, and AI into our most critical business domains . Success will require more than technology implementation, it demands a strategic transformation of core capabilities, a domain based, product centric operating model, and a cultural shift toward experimentation , data and technology fluency, and seamless partnership between business and digital teams.

The Director, Digital Transformation / Scrum Master is responsible for translating Coca-Cola's global digital strategy into a clear, actionable roadmap for the Operating Unit, ensuring strategic priorities are effectively planned, governed, executed, and adopted to deliver measurable business value.
This role serves as the strategic partner between Global Digital Services, Operating Unit leadership, product teams, and business stakeholders to align digital investments with business priorities, manage the regional digital portfolio, and establish the operating model required to maximize value realization.

The Director, Digital Strategy & Planning oversees portfolio planning, governance, demand management, business performance, and change adoption while ensuring the Operating Unit maintains alignment with enterprise digital priorities.

About the opportunity
We are looking for a dynamic, charismatic, and resilient Senior Agile Coach to serve as a strategic leader and galvanizing force within our product and technology org.

Your goal will be to move beyond team coaching to influencing the organization at scale, partnering closely with senior leadership to drive business agility in a heavily regulated industry.

You will be instrumental in framing challenges for the product & technology, and business leaders, and as part of the agile coaching team, you will lead & deliver complex organizational change. You will be challenged to mentor leaders, coaches, and business stakeholders to foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvement across N26.
This role can be based in Berlin, Barcelona, or Vienna.

Put people first and value human interaction over process.
Embrace radical change and aren't scared of ambiguity or the unknown.
Make a positive impact on individuals, teams, and the products they build.
Become a key component of your segment leadership team, partnering with EMs, PMs, and Tech Leads to align OKRs, problems & opportunities and roadmaps.
Own and drive end-to-end change initiatives and strategic improvements across the product development lifecycle.
Mentor and guide less experienced Agile coaches through structured coaching agreements to support their professional growth.
Optimize and improve scaled ways of working.
Design and facilitate large-scale workshops and offsites for domain and leadership levels to solve complex problems and drive alignment.
Be framework agnostic, not dogmatic, and have a diverse problem-solving toolkit.
Have a holistic understanding of how being (not doing) Agile is a great way to build products customers love to use.
Drive change (not just observe it) and transformations and deliver tangible cultural or ways-of-working improvements.
Enable teams to own their work and coach them to be outcome-driven.
Understand that building trust in your teams, senior leaders and with your peers is paramount.
Work across multiple interdependent complex team structures working towards the same goal.
Be comfortable dealing with conflicts and can mediate them effectively.

In 2011 SkySlope started as an idea born at the kitchen table of our CEO, with just him and two others. Headquartered in Sacramento, California, we have since grown out of our previous 3 offices and many of our close to 150 employees are spread all across the United States. Those 150 employees support close to 300,000 users across 5,000 offices nationwide and now in Canada as well. Included in that is 8 out of the 15 largest Real Estate Brokerages in the nation.
But, despite being happy with what we’ve achieved we know that as industry leaders in our space there’s a lot of work left to be done. All of the growth and success that has happened is a result of us obsessing over building cutting edge software that makes the Real Estate world a better place.

We know this only happens by hiring people who don’t just come up with out of the box ideas but hiring people who actually see those ideas through and bring them to life.

As we’ve grown, we’ve been fortunate enough to hire plenty of people who possess that quality and realize it’s equally important to hire people who can pair that skill with empathy, collaboration, and a keen sense of urgency.

If you’re looking to join a company where you can have real impact and surround yourself with an incredible team of people then look no further.

A scrum master is passionate about technology and agile practices. You will lead the agile/scrum practice, leading sprint teams into successful completion of sprints. You will also work with product owners and leadership to facilitate conversations within and outside of the sprint teams.

Begeisterst du dich für die Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung agiler Methoden? Macht es dir Freude, Menschen zu begleiten, Teams zu befähigen und eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit aktiv zu fördern?

Deine Vorteile bei der Post.
Wir bieten einen fairen Lohn, welcher sich je nach Erfahrung und Fähigkeiten zwischen CHF 135’500 bis CHF 150’500 pro Jahr (100%-Pensum) bewegt. Auch Bewerbungen von Talenten mit abweichenden Kompetenzen sind willkommen, in solchen Fällen kann dein Lohn leicht unter oder über der Bandbreite liegen.
Bei uns arbeitest du in einem zukunftsorientierten, dynamischen Umfeld, in dem du dich einbringst und mit dem du weiterwächst. Bei uns erwarten dich verschiedene Benefits, mit denen du deinen Alltag flexibel nach deinen Bedürfnissen gestalten kannst.

Das kannst du bewirken.
· Als Scrum Master unterstützt du unsere DevOps Teams als Servant Leader und befähigst diese zur Selbstorganisation und zum eigenverantwortlichen Handeln nach den agilen Prinzipien und Rollen.
· Du förderst eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und unterstützt die Teams dabei, Herausforderungen und Hindernisse erfolgreich zu meistern.
· Durch den regelmässigen Austausch mit anderen Scrum Mastern entwickelst du neue Ideen und förderst die organisationsweite Zusammenarbeit. Für den fachlichen Austausch und die gegenseitige Unterstützung kannst du auf eine engagierte Community zählen.
· Als Agile Leader schaffst du die optimalen Rahmenbedingungen, damit die Teams wertstiftende Ergebnisse liefern und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln können. Bei Bedarf stehen dir unsere Agile Coaches unterstützend zur Seite.
· Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die agilen Entwicklungsteams und begleitest sie in ihrer Weiterentwicklung.
Das bringst du mit.
· Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung als Scrum Master in agilen Teams und Organisationen.
· Fundierte Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung mit agilen Frameworks zeichnen dich aus; eine SAFe-Zertifizierung oder entsprechende Aus- und Weiterbildungen sind von Vorteil.
· Du arbeitest gerne im Team und überzeugst durch deine kommunikativen Fähigkeiten, Empathie, dein gutes Gespür für Menschen sowie deine Koordinationsstärke und dein vorausschauendes Handeln.
· Als flexible sowie eigenständige Persönlichkeit, schaffst du durch lösungsorientiertes Handeln eine gute Mischung zwischen methodischer Standfestigkeit und Pragmatismus.
· Du kommunizierst mündlich und schriftlich gut in einer ersten Landessprache, verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in einer zweiten Landessprache sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.
